name: clawshelf
description: Free Agent Skills by ClawShelf. Each pack is a plugin that bundles standard SKILL.md skills.

plugins.name: memory-starter-kit
plugins.description: Equip your agent with persistent memory and personal context to maintain continuity and recognize user preferences across every session.

clawshelf.summaryZh: 为 Agent 配齐持久记忆和个人档案，跨对话保持连贯，记住你的偏好。
clawshelf.releaseNotes: Packs are now Claude Code plugins too: /plugin marketplace add billyhetech/clawshelf-skills.

plugins.name: security-first-kit
plugins.description: Secure your agent setup by hardening configurations, monitoring agent behavior, and vetting every skill before installation.

clawshelf.summaryZh: 加固安装配置、监控 Agent 行为、安装前审查每个技能，一套装齐。
clawshelf.releaseNotes: Moved to the public clawshelf-skills repo; installs in any Agent Skills-compatible agent.

plugins.name: day-one-kit
plugins.description: Start every day organized: a morning briefing, natural-language reminders, and instant summaries of anything you read or watch.

clawshelf.summaryZh: 从第一天就井井有条：晨间简报、自然语言提醒，读到看到的内容一键摘要。
clawshelf.releaseNotes: First release in the public clawshelf-skills repo.

plugins.name: basic-memory
plugins.description: Equip your agent with persistent memory by automatically saving facts, preferences, and decisions across every conversation session.

plugins.name: morning-brief
plugins.description: A concise, prioritized daily briefing: weather, today's schedule, urgent email highlights, and a suggested action plan.

plugins.name: openclaw-hardening
plugins.description: Harden your OpenClaw setup by auditing security misconfigurations like exposed listeners, missing auth, and insecure permissions before installing additional skills.

plugins.name: permission-guard
plugins.description: Secure your OpenClaw agent by monitoring skill behavior, detecting unauthorized access, and generating detailed permission audit reports.

plugins.name: personal-context
plugins.description: Personalize every session by building a persistent profile that remembers your name, timezone, and communication style.

plugins.name: quick-reminder
plugins.description: Set, manage, and receive reminders in plain natural language.

plugins.name: skill-scanner
plugins.description: Protect your agent by scanning skills for malicious patterns, prompt injections, and permission abuse before you install them.

plugins.name: smart-summarizer
plugins.description: Transform long articles, videos, and PDFs into concise digests with TL;DRs and actionable insights in seconds.
